title: Close evidence boundary and add shared result cleanup
description: Remove or explicitly gate the unexpected provider answer field at the web_search boundary. Add conservative URL canonicalization/sourceUrl preservation, shared result validation/bounds/deduplication, and canonical research fetch identity. Preserve evidence-first output, hard constraints, and offline tests.

logs.msg: Implemented src/search-cleanup.ts at executeSearch boundary: conservative HTTP URL identity, fragment/default-port/host normalization, sourceUrl preservation, field bounds, score/date cleanup, duplicate merge, malformed-result warnings, and post-dedup maxResults. Reused identity for web_research fetch deduplication, removed opaque answer leakage from web_search, and removed the versioned user-agent string. bun run check passes: 111 tests, 256 assertions.
